player_prompt.intro: Ku soo dhawow Badda Barafka! Waxaa lagu matalaa 'P' shabakadda. Calaamadaha shabakadda: ' ' = Dusha barafka (ammaan u ah socodka) ' H ' = Godka (ku dhaco oo lumiso!) ' G ' = Goolka (ku gaadho tan si aad u guuleysato!) ' P ' = Meesha aad hadda joogto Waxqabadyada la heli karo: kor, hoos, bidix, midig (ama w, a, s, d) Ku qor ficilkaaga sida: [up], [down], [left], [right] ama [w], [a], [s], [d] Ujeedada: Ka soo gudub bilowga (bidix-bidix) ilaa yoolka (hoos-midig) adigoon ku dhicin godad !

board.current_board: Guddiga hadda jira: {board} Waxqabadyada la heli karo: {actions}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Qaabka ficilku waa mid aan ansax ahayn. Isticmaal [up], [down], [left], [right] ama [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Waxqabadka aan la garanayn '{action}'. Isticmaal kor, hoos, bidix, midig, ama w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Waxaad jaahdeen inaad u guuraasho {action} laakiin waxaad ku kulmeen dabaq!

outcome.fell_in_hole: Waxaad ku dhacday god! Ciyaarta dhamaatay. Waxaad dhameysay {pct}% safarka goolka.
outcome.turn_limit: Waxaad gaadhay xadka wareega! Ciyaarta dhamaatay. Waxaad dhammaysay {pct}% safarka goolka.
